cues.text: Good morning. Sunset Hotel. How may I help you?
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: Good morning. I just saw an advert in the paper about your hotel.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Where exactly is it located?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: We are situated on Sunset Avenue, north of the beach.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: Close to many scenic spots, it is an ideal choice for travellers interested in sightseeing.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: That’s great. Is there a vacant four-bed room?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: We’ll be travelling with our two sons aged 9 and 11, so it’s best that we are able to stay in one room.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Let me check, just a moment...Um. we only have a few four-bed rooms, and I’m afraid they are fully booked at the moment.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: The earliest time available is August, but there might be some left in July if a previous customer cancels the reservation.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: Oh, that’ll do. How much would the room cost me?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: It’s 77.50 euros during peak time, but the price would be much lower during off-peak season.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: Only 50 euros.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: So if I book a room right now, is there any discount?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Yes. We do offer a 30% discount for any reservation made one month ahead of schedule. It is a very reasonable price.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: That does sound tempting. Does the price include anything?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: The price includes two breakfast vouchers per room per day.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: You can use them at two different restaurants in our hotel.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: There’s also a 20-minute spa trial available, but you have to book it beforehand at the concierge or directly at the Spa Centre.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: Um, I’m wondering if there is a hairdryer in the room.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: It takes ages to dry my hair without one. Do I have to bring one?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: No, there is absolutely no need to bring that for each room is equipped with a hairdryer.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: But I have to inform you that towels are not provided.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: You’ll have to bring your own or hire some at the front desk.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: Oh, I see.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Before making a reservation, can you tell me a little bit more about your hotel?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Sure, no problem. We aim to please our guests by providing impeccable service and all the modem amenities, trying to make them feel at home.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: In the lounge, there are a list of books, ranging from contemporary literature to classic poetry, free for any guest to read.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: There is also a games room offering a number of indoor games including popular board games like Monopoly as well as the beloved Table Soccer.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: A nice place to go to on rainy days.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: Are there computers available in the hotel?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: 1 might have a few emails to respond to during my stay there.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: I’m afraid we currently co not provide any for our customers.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: However, Internet is available within our hotel premises.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: Just use the room number and guest name to log in.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: That means I have to bring my own laptop then. All right.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Um, because I’m travelling with my two sons, is there anything that they might be interested in?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Yes, a popular activity here for children is collecting shells on the beach.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: Our hotel has a private beach. When there are very few visitors, you can take a stroll down the beach with your children and enjoy some quality family time undisturbed.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: That sounds nice, but you see my boys really love adventure.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Is there something more exciting for them to participate in?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: We do have bicycles ready for hire.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: You can cycle with the boys along the bush track by the hotel, which is an ideal place to explore the wonders of nature.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: But, because there's only a limited number of bicycles, we apply a "first come first serve" rule.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: Got it. I think my boys would love it.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: How can arrange the payment, then? Can I pay by credit card?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Of course. We take credit cards.
cues.speaker: Receptionist

cues.text: Thank you. You've been a great help.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: My pleasure, ma'am.
cues.speaker: Receptionist
